title: Degenerate and connection-dependent cosmological sectors in f(Q,C) gravity
summary: We investigate cosmological solutions in $f(Q,C)$ gravity formulated within symmetric teleparallel geometry, where gravitation is described by the nonmetricity scalar $Q$ and the boundary term $C$, related to the Ricci scalar of General Relativity through $\mathring{R}=Q+C$ in the absence of curvature and torsion. The symmetry requirements of FLRW spacetime admit three distinct realizations of the affine connection, leading in principle to three different cosmological sectors within the same theory.
